q.line: The lines are fading in my kingdom
stanza: The lines are fading in my kingdom
(Though I have never known the way to border them in);
So the muddy mouths of baboons and sows, and the grouse, and the horse, and the…
Grope at the gate of the looming lake that was once a tidy pen
And the mail is late, and the great estates are not lit from within
The talk in town's becoming downright sickening

partner.line: (Though I have never known the way to border them in);

q.line: And whose kingdom may have just gone home with another kingdom
stanza: Honey, I don't know what you just heard
"Bartender, set 'em up" are my favorite words
Because the love I need is a long way from here
Oh, the love I need is a long way from here
Yes, well, there I sat so all alone
Like a king who sits upon his throne
And whose kingdom may have just gone home with another kingdom

partner.line: Oh, the love I need is a long way from here
